name: 84653 · Salem, UT
findings: ZIP 84653 (Salem) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84653 (Salem) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
